definitions.gloss: counter for letters, documents, and written communications
definitions.explanation: Used to count pieces of mail, official documents, and written communications.

examples.japanese: {手紙|てがみ}を{3通|さんつう}{書|か}いた。
{応募書類|おうぼしょるい}は{2通|につう}{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: Two copies of the application documents are required.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{何通|なんつう}メールが{来|き}ましたか。
{契約書|けいやくしょ}を{2通|につう}{作|つく}って、{1通|いっつう}は{相手|あいて}に{渡|わた}す。
examples.english: Make two copies of the contract and give one to the other party.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}になると、{毎年|まいとし}{何十通|なんじゅっつう}もの{年賀状|ねんがじょう}を{書|か}かなければならない。
examples.english: At year-end, I have to write dozens of New Year's cards every year.

notes:
COUNTING:
・{一|いっ}{通|つう} (1 letter)
・{二|に}{通|つう} (2 letters)
・{三|さん}{通|つう} (3 letters)
・{何通|なんつう} (how many letters)

COMMON USES:
・{手紙|てがみ} (letters)
・メール (emails)
・{書類|しょるい} (documents)
・{履歴書|りれきしょ} (resumes)
・{申請書|しんせいしょ} (applications)

NOTE: This counter emphasizes the 'through/communication' aspect ({通|つう}じる = to communicate). Different from {枚|まい} which counts flat objects by their physical form.
